items.passageEn: Last Saturday, Mia took a cooking class. First, the teacher showed them how to boil water and cook carrots, peas and mushrooms. Then they cut tomatoes into thin slices. At the end of the class, everyone made a big bowl of vegetable soup. Mia ate it with a spoon and drank a cold soda. "I'll cook this for my family!" she said.
items.passageZh: 上週六，Mia 上了一堂烹飪課。老師先教大家怎麼燒開水，以及怎麼煮紅蘿蔔、豌豆和蘑菇。接著他們把番茄切成薄片。最後，每個人都做了一大碗蔬菜湯。Mia 用湯匙喝湯，還喝了一杯冰汽水。她說：「我要煮這道湯給家人吃！」

items.promptZh: 這碗湯裡有太多紅蘿蔔了。
referenceEn: There are too many carrots in this soup.
This soup has too many carrots.
rubricZh: carrot 是可數名詞，這裡用複數（例如 carrots）
「太多」接可數名詞用 too many

items.promptZh: 大家都喜歡我媽媽的廚藝。
rubricZh: 用 cooking 表示「廚藝」（例如 my mother's cooking）
everyone、everybody 後面用單數動詞（例如 loves、likes 等）
